candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal S-series), Montenegro-filtered notices
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes in full all EU/IPA-funded contract notices, award notices and modifications where the place of performance or contracting authority is Montenegro, including EU Delegation Podgorica service contracts for financial-sector and public-finance IT. Award notices name the winning supplier/consortium and value — the single richest supranational vendor-attribution source for ME.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API v3 (developer.ted.europa.eu) with expert query on place-of-performance=ME plus CPV 72xxxxxx/48xxxxxx and banking keywords; fall back to bulk XML/CSV daily packages. Avoid HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from EU procurement notices referencing Montenegro
queries_used: TED tenders electronic daily Montenegro banking information system IPA contract notice

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders / Publications Office 'EU tenders' procurement database (DG NEAR, IPA external actions)
candidates.why_relevant: Hosts procurement detail pages for EU-institution and IPA-financed contracts covering the Western Balkans, e.g. WBIF Infrastructure Project Facility TA lots including the Digital sector; discloses scope, budget and awardee for the consultancy consortia that design financial-infrastructure projects before national rollout.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch procurement-detail permalinks discovered via TED cross-references; periodic keyword crawl on 'Western Balkans', 'Montenegro', 'digital', 'financial'.
queries_used: WBIF Western Balkans Investment Framework Montenegro digital infrastructure grant technical assistance

candidates.source_name: EEAS — Delegation of the European Union to Montenegro: tender and contract award notices
candidates.why_relevant: The EU Delegation in Podgorica is the contracting authority for a large share of IPA service contracts in Montenegro (public finance management, public procurement reform, investment agency TA). It publishes service contract award notices with contractor name and contract value, plus cancellation notices — often the earliest public naming of the implementing consultancy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the delegation's news/tenders sections in both /_en and /_me variants; harvest attached .docx/.pdf award notices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on IPA + javna nabavka + EU delegacija
queries_used: IPA projekat Crna Gora finansijski sektor javna nabavka ugovor EU delegacija
KfW Montenegro procurement notices tender financial sector Crna Gora KfW Entwicklungsbank

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP) — Montenegro notices
candidates.why_relevant: Since migration from the legacy notices page, ECEPP is where EBRD-financed clients publish general procurement notices, prequalification, shortlists and contract award notices for goods/works/consultancy in Montenegro — including PIU support and institutional/financial-sector consultancy. Award records give supplier legal name, country and contract value.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised notice-list requests filtered by country=Montenegro; follow displayNoticeId permalinks. Respect rate limits; portal is session/JS-heavy so consider headless browser.
queries_used: EBRD procurement Montenegro financial sector consultancy contract award

candidates.source_name: EBRD Contract Awards Notification pages (project procurement)
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated EBRD disclosure of awarded project contracts; complements ECEPP by giving a structured, historically archived view of who won EBRD-financed contracts in Montenegro.

queries_used: EBRD procurement Montenegro financial sector consultancy contract award

candidates.source_name: EBRD corporate consultancy contract awards lists (annual PDFs)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual PDF lists of consultancy contracts awarded by EBRD itself reveal which advisory firms EBRD repeatedly uses for financial-sector assignments in the Western Balkans; useful for competitor/partner mapping even when the assignment country is aggregated.

candidates.source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — Montenegro project pages (incl. Financial Infrastructure Modernization / SEPA TIPS-clone project)
candidates.why_relevant: The EUR 8m Montenegro Financial Infrastructure Modernization and SEPA Alignment Project (TIPS clone, Banca d'Italia solution) is the single most consequential donor-funded payments programme in ME. Project pages carry PAD, procurement plans, PIDs and implementation status reports naming the beneficiary (CBCG/Ministry of Finance) and the technical solution — a direct pipeline signal for payment-systems vendors.

negative_findings.description: No TED contract notice or award specifically for a Montenegrin banking/core-banking or payment information system funded by IPA surfaced in general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: General web search returns only TED platform documentation, not ME-specific banking notices; TED's own faceted search or API is required because notice text is not well indexed by general engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that TED must be queried through its native search/API rather than via search engines, otherwise ME financial-sector notices will be systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: EBRD Montenegro results were dominated by non-financial-sector assignments (PIU support/mobility consultancy); no EBRD financial-sector systems contract award for ME was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one concrete ME award found (MC Mobility Consultants GmbH, PIU establishment/training, EUR 225,900, signed 06/05/2025) — transport, not finance.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: EBRD's ME financial-sector activity may run through credit lines to banks (no public procurement) rather than procured systems contracts, so ECEPP should be monitored but weighted lower than World Bank/TED.

negative_findings.description: No KfW-financed financial-sector procurement notice for Montenegro was found; KfW's visible ME footprint in results is energy (HPP Perućica).
negative_findings.result_summary: KfW appears as buyer only for an energy tender; financial cooperation with ME banks does not appear to generate public procurement notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-investing collection effort in a low-yield channel; KfW stays as low-priority monitoring.

negative_findings.description: Montenegrin/Serbian-language searching surfaces national procurement vocabulary well but almost never surfaces supranational award notices, because funders publish awards in English only.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr queries using 'javna nabavka', 'ugovor', 'obavještenje', 'platni promet', 'informacioni sistem' returned national portals, aggregators and EU Delegation news, not IFI award records.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language collection for this cell should target beneficiary-side confirmation (ministries, CBCG, press) rather than the award records themselves, which must be collected in English.

negative_findings.description: IFC Disclosure Portal was inferred as a required channel from first principles but no Montenegro financial-institution disclosure page was actually retrieved in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Listed as a candidate with reduced confidence; no example_urls recorded because none were observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must confirm the ME/FI filter yields records before this source is promoted.

coverage_gaps.description: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), Green for Growth Fund / EFSE and other EU-blended financial-sector funds active in the Western Balkans were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep for CEB, EFSE, GGF, EU Growth Plan / Reform Agenda for Montenegro disbursement conditions touching payments and digital finance.

coverage_gaps.description: TED Search API and World Bank STEP/Finances One datasets were identified but neither query syntax nor a working ME+finance CPV filter has been validated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test a TED expert query (place-of-performance=ME AND CPV in 48/66/72 families) and a Finances One Montenegro contract-awards export in the collection phase.

coverage_gaps.description: Montenegro's national IPA contract register (CFCU / indirect-management contract lists under the Ministry of Finance) was not located as a discrete published dataset.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search gov.me for annual IPA implementation reports and any 'lista ugovora'/'registar ugovora' publication; ask whether CEJN carries IPA-funded awards.

coverage_gaps.description: For the flagship WB SEPA/TIPS-clone project, the beneficiary and technical solution (Banca d'Italia TIPS clone) are known but no procurement package or awarded implementer has yet been identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Track P509405 procurement plan in STEP and CBCG announcements quarterly; the systems-integration and connectivity packages are the commercially relevant ones.

brief: Montenegro's supranational financial-infrastructure procurement is concentrated in three channels: TED/EU Delegation Podgorica for IPA service contracts, the World Bank (Projects API, Documents & Reports, and STEP-derived contract-award datasets) for the flagship EUR 8m Financial Infrastructure Modernization / SEPA TIPS-clone project, and the WBIF-EBRD-EIB technical-assistance layer that writes tender documents 12-24 months ahead of national procurement. EBRD, UNDP and KfW are live but low-yield for financial-sector systems specifically: EBRD's visible ME awards are transport/PIU, UNDP's are government ICT hardware, and KfW's are energy. Award-level vendor attribution is published almost exclusively in English by the funders, so Montenegrin/Serbian sources (CBCG press releases, gov.me/mif EU funds pages, ujn.gov.me 'EU tenderi') are best used for beneficiary-side confirmation and timing rather than as the award record. The main readiness gap is machine access: the TED Search API query and a Finances One Montenegro contract-awards export must be built and validated before systematic collection begins.
